page.content:
Smiling sister city across the sand, later a StrexCorp company town.

How Desert Bluffs connects

  • Faction: StrexCorp Synernists Inc. — StrexCorp owns Desert Bluffs as a company town.
  • Character: Kevin — Kevin hosts radio from Desert Bluffs.
  • Location: Night Vale — Desert Bluffs is Night Vale's smiling sister city across the sand.

What is Desert Bluffs?

Desert Bluffs is Night Vale's neighbor and rival, a brighter, bloodier town whose radio host Kevin and whose StrexCorp ownership make it the smiling double of Cecil's home.

Key threads lead to StrexCorp Synernists Inc., Kevin and Night Vale.
